snippet.title: Grave Orbit Trailer #1
snippet.description:
Grave Orbit is an incremental defense game about protecting a central Core while building a growing production and defense network around it.

Collect Scrap, turn it into Parts, keep your ammo and energy systems running, build turrets and support modules, and upgrade your base between runs as the campaign escalates across 16 chapters.

The game also includes two campaign protocols with very different pacing, a separate story-driven Prequel, and endless Skirmish modes.

Grave Orbit is coming to Steam and will be part of the October Steam Next Fest.

Wishlist and play the demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5028180/Grave_Orbit/

#GraveOrbit #IndieGame #TowerDefense #IncrementalGame #StrategyGame
